title: Rory and the Velvet Mossy Glade
verses:
The silver moon climbed up the sky,
To light the sleepy fern,
And Rory found a quiet spot,
Where shadows softly turn.

Then Tilly stretched upon the ground,
Beside the quiet stream,
And Benny leaned against a log,
To start a gentle dream.

Then Ricky curled a scaly tail,
And put away his play,
While Nia swooped upon the wind,
To chase the day away.

Then Psittaco began to chirp,
A tiny sleepy tune,
And fluttered down to hide away,
Beneath the glowing moon.

The forest grew so calm and still,
The leaves began to weep,
As Rory tucked his green tail in,
And drifted into sleep.

The stars above watched over all,
The night was warm and deep,
And Rory rested safe and sound,
Until the morning peep.
